title: Open ATS job posting
description: One open job posting, normalised across Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever into a single schema. Fields the vendor does not provide are null rather than guessed.

source.title: ATS
source.description: Which applicant tracking system this posting came from: greenhouse, ashby or lever.

company.title: Company
company.description: The company's board token on that ATS. It is the vendor's own identifier, so it is stable and joinable.

job_id.title: Job ID
job_id.description: The vendor's own posting ID. Unique within a company board, and stable across runs, so it is what you deduplicate on.

title.title: Title
title.description: The job title, exactly as the company wrote it.

location.title: Location
location.description: The location string as published. Not normalised — companies write it too many ways for a mapping to be honest.

workplace.title: Workplace
workplace.description: remote, hybrid or onsite. Taken from the vendor's own workplace field where one exists, and inferred from the location text otherwise.

department.title: Department
department.description: The department as published, e.g. Engineering, Sales. Null where the vendor does not carry one.

team.title: Team
team.description: The team within the department, where the ATS provides it.

employment_type.title: Employment type
employment_type.description: Full-time, contract, internship and so on, where the ATS provides it.

posted_at.title: Posted
posted_at.description: When the posting first went live, ISO 8601.

updated_at.title: Updated
updated_at.description: When the posting last changed, ISO 8601. This is what the postedSince filter compares against, so it is the field to poll on for a daily delta.

salary_min.title: Salary min
salary_min.description: Parsed from the published compensation range. Null when the company did not publish one — never estimated.

salary_max.title: Salary max
salary_max.description: Parsed from the published compensation range. Null when the company did not publish one — never estimated.

salary_currency.title: Currency
salary_currency.description: ISO currency code for the parsed range.

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: intern, junior, mid, senior, principal or executive. Inferred from the title — it is a convenience, not a fact the company published.

description.title: Description
description.description: Full plain-text job description. Only present when includeDescription is on; it is roughly ten times the size of everything else.

index_as_of.title: Index date
index_as_of.description: The date the company index was last swept. Boards open and close; the postings themselves are always fetched live at run time.

fetched_at.title: Fetched
fetched_at.description: When this run read the board.
